name: Temple Emanuel Mah Jongg
description: Temple Emanuel hosts Learn and Play: Mah Jongg classes and Mah Jongg open play. Its class page says attendees must "purchase a 2026 Mah Jongg card from the National Mah Jongg League prior to class".
schedule: Open play 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month 6:30-8:30 PM (reservation required online); Learn and Play class $50 for 4 sessions ($25 members), Oct 14-Nov 4 2026

name: Sparrow and Dragon
description: Bam Good Time group offering beginner mahjong lessons and open play events in Greensboro. The group's own page does not mention American or NMJL; a Greensboro Chamber listing describes bespoke lessons and guided open plays. Needs confirmation of American/NMJL.
schedule: Event listed Nov 4 2026 at Martin's Mercantile

name: Creative Aging Network-NC
description: Guilford County-funded senior center that lists a 4-part Mahjongg for Beginners class taught by Maxine Campbell. The page does not say American or NMJL.
schedule: Saturdays 1:00-3:00 PM Nov 7, 14, 21 and Dec 5 2026; page says $120 covers all instruction and materials
